prompt: While writing an essay, Zoe checks each incoming message 'for just a second'. Each check is brief, yet the essay takes twice as long and has more errors. What best explains this?

options.text: Messages contain information, so checking them cannot slow writing
Her essay topic must be boring, which is the only possible cause
Every switch carries a refocusing cost: after each check she must reload where she was and what she meant to say next
She would write faster if she checked messages even more often

explanation: Attention does not switch for free. The seconds spent checking are minor compared with the repeated cost of reconstructing the thread of the work after each interruption.
